_doc: One Grok bot, Find Me Money, that only orchestrates. Each routine hands one job (jobs/<job>.md) to the Claude Code CLI through tools/job.py. routines: name, cron (UTC), what the run does. tools/team.py, tools/install.py and tools/check.py read this.
name: Find Me Money

agents.does: The funding bot: content first, Lead Radar, Skool and Whop, partnership outreach, the GoHighLevel CRM. It orchestrates; the Claude Code CLI does every job
routines: Run python3 repo/tools/job.py run content --note "morning: three pieces from today's plan and the calendar"

First save today's new posts from each signed-in Skool and Whop community in context/communities.md to data/communities/<date>/<name>.txt with your browser. Then run python3 repo/tools/job.py run communities
Run python3 repo/tools/job.py run content --note "afternoon: three pieces answering what Lead Radar and the communities found today"
Run python3 repo/tools/job.py run report. Then post daily/<date>/report.md, as it is, to Slack and to the Notion hub
